text: The due-diligence file from June 2025 stating no loss was detected on the property is no longer valid. As of November 12, 2026, a tree-cover loss candidate of 13.5 hectares was detected in 2025 within the asset. However, this change is still pending corroboration, meaning it needs to be confirmed by observations from a later year. The cause and legality of the change are not established by the current evidence.
